title: More control over files and the command palette
notes: New: Add comments to files and folders, edit link targets, navigate to network locations, and pass program arguments to Open With apps.
Improved: The command palette now scales with font size, fits narrow windows better, and can run commands with administrator privileges; dialogs use a unified in-window style.
Fixed: Select All can skip directories, sessions save reliably when closing, and plugin synchronization, themes, compact view, and modal controls behave more reliably.
